title: Anonymous-mode core usage (remove Internet Identity gating) + industrial theme refresh

requirements.summary: Make core report routes usable anonymously by removing any auth-gated redirects/blocks and ensuring report entry/history/detail render without login/signup flows.
acceptanceCriteria: When opening the app in a fresh browser (no stored Internet Identity session), navigating to / renders the report entry UI (not a login/signup screen).
/history and /report/:reportId render without requiring Internet Identity.
No UI flow forces the user to authenticate via Internet Identity in order to create/view reports.
No user-facing text on these anonymous flows says or implies that signing in/signing up is required.

file_operations.description: Refactor route composition to ensure the main routes (/, /history, /report/$reportId) are always reachable in anonymous mode (no redirect/render to LoginScreen/ProfileSetup/SignupPendingAccessScreen for these routes). Keep admin route guard behavior separate and unchanged for admin-only paths.

Add a small routing/UI gate component that explicitly prioritizes anonymous access for core pages and only allows authenticated-only UI (e.g., profile setup / approval screens) to appear when the user is positively authenticated and the app is intentionally in an authenticated flow (never as a blocker for core report pages).
Wire AnonymousModeGate into the app shell so core content always renders for anonymous users while still allowing authenticated-only flows to be shown when relevant.
Update copy so it does not imply login is required for core report usage, and ensure the component is not used as a blocker for core routes in anonymous mode.
Ensure ProfileSetup is not auto-invoked as a blocker for core report routes; keep it usable only for explicit authenticated/profile flows if still needed elsewhere.
Ensure pending-access UI is not auto-invoked as a blocker for core report routes; keep it usable only for explicit authenticated/approval flows if still needed elsewhere.

requirements.summary: Update header/navigation for anonymous mode by hiding identity-dependent UI and ensuring admin navigation stays hidden unless admin is positively confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: In anonymous mode, the header does not show a user name/username block.
In anonymous mode, the header does not show a "Sign Out" button/menu item.
The "Users" (admin) navigation is not visible unless admin status is positively confirmed; it is never visible for anonymous users.

file_operations.description: Adjust header rendering rules so identity-dependent UI (user name/username block, sign-out actions) only appears when a profile is available; keep admin navigation hidden unless admin status is positively confirmed and never visible to anonymous users.

requirements.summary: Keep admin-only routes protected from anonymous access by showing access denied (without prompting Internet Identity login).
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /admin/users while anonymous shows an access denied UI (not an Internet Identity login prompt).
Admin routes remain accessible only when the existing admin-check logic positively confirms admin status.

file_operations.description: Ensure the /admin/users route remains guarded by positive admin confirmation and that anonymous users are routed to an access denied UI without any login/signup prompt.
Update AccessDeniedScreen messaging to be action-oriented (return home) and explicitly avoid any Internet Identity login prompt or language implying authentication is required.
Confirm admin-only page behavior remains consistent with anonymous-mode: if user is not positively confirmed admin, show AccessDeniedScreen without any login/signup prompt.

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent industrial/service-reporting theme across anonymous-mode screens and navigation, avoiding blue/purple as primary brand colors.
acceptanceCriteria: Anonymous-mode pages and navigation look visually consistent (shared typography, spacing, and component styling).
Primary theme does not use blue/purple as the main brand colors.

file_operations.description: Adjust global design tokens (colors/typography/spacing defaults) to an industrial/service-reporting aesthetic (e.g., neutral grays + safety/amber accents) and ensure primary branding avoids blue/purple.
Align any non-src global Tailwind base/theme variables with the updated industrial palette to keep anonymous-mode navigation and screens visually consistent.
Update Tailwind theme mappings (primary/accent/success/warning tokens as applicable) to support the new industrial palette without introducing blue/purple as the primary brand colors.
Ensure header styling (background, borders, typography emphasis) uses the updated industrial palette consistently across anonymous and authenticated states.
Ensure layout spacing and container styling remains consistent with the updated theme across anonymous-mode core pages and navigation.
